blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives is coordinating with the Senate to once again open to the public the joint congressional talks on the P7.2-trillion spending plan for next year, Nueva Ecija Rep. Mikaela Angela Suansing said on Tuesday. She said congressmen are organizing efforts to open the traditionally close-door budget talks with senators for the second time, as the spending bill moves forward plenary discussions at the House. “We are coordinating with our counterparts in the Senate to open the bicameral conference committee proceedings to the public for the second year in history,” Suansing told lawmakers at the House […]...
